description: This file defines API routes and models for authentication-related operations in a FastAPI application, including OAuth login, OAuth callback, token refresh, and API key management.

classes.name: OAuthLoginRequest
classes.description: Request model for initiating OAuth login, containing connector info, tenant and connection identifiers, scopes, and redirect URI.

classes.name: OAuthLoginResponse
classes.description: Response model providing the authorization URL and state for OAuth login.

classes.name: OAuthCallbackResponse
classes.description: Response after OAuth callback, indicating success, tenant, connection, and token expiry.

classes.name: OAuthRefreshRequest
classes.description: Request model for refreshing OAuth access tokens, including tenant, connection info, token URL, client credentials, and extra parameters.

classes.name: OAuthRefreshResponse
classes.description: Response after refreshing OAuth tokens, with status message and expiry info.

classes.name: ApiKeyUpsertRequest
classes.description: Request for setting/updating an API key, including tenant, connection, and API key details.

classes.name: ApiKeyVerifyRequest
classes.description: Request for verifying an API key against stored hash.

classes.name: ApiKeyResponse
classes.description: Standard response indicating result of API key verification or storage.

classes.name: OAuthState
classes.description: TypedDict defining the structure of OAuth state payload containing tenant, connection, connector, and nonce.

methods.name: _tenant_tokens_collection(tenant_id: str)
methods.description: Helps access the tenant's token records collection.

methods.name: bytes _aad(tenant_id: str, connection_id: str)
methods.description: Generates associated ciphertext for tenant/connection to reduce token replay risk.

methods.name: Optional[datetime] _upsert_oauth_tokens( *, tenant_id: str, connection_id: str, access_token: str, refresh_token: Optional[str], expires_in: Optional[int], )
methods.description: Inserts or updates OAuth tokens in database for a tenant/connection.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] _get_oauth_record(tenant_id: str, connection_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves OAuth token record for specific tenant and connection.

methods.name: None _upsert_api_key( *, tenant_id: str, connection_id: str, api_key_plain: str, header_name: Optional[str], prefix: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Stores or updates the hashed API key in the database for a tenant/connection.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] _get_api_key_record(tenant_id: str, connection_id: str)
methods.description: Fetches stored API key record for a tenant/connection.

methods.name: ApiKeyResponse verify_api_key_route(req: ApiKeyVerifyRequest, ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Endpoint to verify provided API key against stored hash.

methods.name: OAuthLoginResponse oauth_login(req: OAuthLoginRequest, ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Starts OAuth flow by generating authorization URL and signed state.

methods.name: OAuthCallbackResponse oauth_callback( request: Request, code: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Authorization code returned by the provider."), state: str = Query(..., description="Opaque state parameter returned by the provider."), error: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Optional error returned by provider."), error_description: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Optional error description."), ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context), )
methods.description: Handles OAuth callback, exchanges code for tokens, stores credentials.

methods.name: OAuthRefreshResponse oauth_refresh(req: OAuthRefreshRequest, ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Uses stored refresh token to obtain new access token and updates database.

methods.name: ApiKeyResponse set_api_key_async(req: ApiKeyUpsertRequest, ctx: TenantContext = Depends(get_tenant_context), request: Request = None)
methods.description: Stores or updates an API key for a connection, securely hashing it.
